text.tspan: Problem: a sudden spike (1,000 videos to encode
instead of the usual 10) hits the receiver directly.
If it is slow or down, the caller fails too.
2) Asynchronous / event based: app → queue → app
The queue absorbs the spike. Each side scales
These services scale independently from your application. SQS, SNS and Kinesis are "cloud-native" (AWS APIs);
Amazon MQ is for apps that already speak open protocols (added: your notes skipped MQ).
"decouple tiers / buffer writes / absorb spikes" → SQS · "send one event to many" → SNS (+ SQS fan-out)
"real-time big data, replay, ordering per key" → Kinesis Data Streams · "load stream into S3/Redshift" → Data Firehose · "lift-and-shift JMS/AMQP/MQTT" → MQ
